gap_policies.reader_label_zh: 供应产能释放时间与 Dell 分配
gap_policies.reader_label_en: Supplier capacity release timing and Dell allocation
gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: A supplier ramp does not establish when capacity becomes usable or how much reaches Dell.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: An official supplier timetable plus Dell disclosure or verifiable allocation evidence.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Supplier capacity is industry context until Dell allocation is directly supported.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: No Dell capacity quantity or delivery share may be inferred.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Do not declare non-disclosure until reachable official routes and candidate admission are receipted.

gap_policies.reader_label_zh: HBM 供给、良率与 Dell 分配
gap_policies.reader_label_en: HBM supply, yield and Dell allocation
gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: General memory commentary does not establish HBM availability, yield or Dell-specific allocation.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: Admissible HBM capacity, tightness, yield or allocation evidence tied to the relevant period and relationship.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Memory-industry evidence remains context unless the Dell delivery path is proved.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: No HBM quantity, yield or Dell share may be created from narrative context.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Generic memory news and unavailable routes do not prove a public-information boundary.

gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: Product ramps and advanced-node revenue are not measurements of utilization or yield.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: Supplier prepared remarks or audited capacity, utilization or yield disclosure for the relevant period.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Supplier process metrics cannot be converted into Dell delivery metrics without a relationship bridge.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: No utilization or yield percentage may be inferred from ramp language.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Preserve a commercial-data boundary if admissible sources remain unavailable after the full ladder.

gap_policies.reader_label_zh: 增长预期是否已反映在价格中
gap_policies.reader_label_en: Whether growth expectations are priced in
gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: Operating growth cannot be translated into an investment view without point-in-time market context.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: A bound market price, valuation interval and explicit as-of date with comparable definitions.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Peer or sector multiples cannot substitute for Dell point-in-time market facts.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: Market PIT and valuation calculations must be produced by the numeric authority layer.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Do not present a price-in conclusion while the market PIT surface is absent.

gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: A thesis without frozen scenario inputs does not show how uncertainty changes value or risk.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: Reproducible base facts plus explicit owner assumptions, ranges and sensitivity formulas.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Industry scenarios may inform assumptions but are not Dell reported facts.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: Every scenario value must be typed as an assumption or estimate, never an exact fact.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Do not generate model-memory valuation inputs or backfill a false exact point estimate.

gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: The report cannot make a valuation claim without a dated price and a defined multiple or cash-flow basis.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: Market PIT data or owner-supplied valuation date, metric definitions and comparable basis.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: A peer multiple is context until its period, metric and comparability are reconciled to Dell.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: Valuation inputs and formulas require period, unit and source lineage in S2.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: No valuation or price-in conclusion may be written from filing-only evidence.

gap_policies.reader_label_zh: AI 营运资金归因与规模
gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: Company balance-sheet movements are only proxies until product attribution and a cash-flow reconciliation are available.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: Qualified review of existing candidates followed, if still needed, by Dell product attribution, turnover or reconciled cash-flow disclosure.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Company totals cannot be assigned to the AI product line without direct attribution.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: AR, inventory and AP stock changes are not an AI cash-absorption measure.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Do not call the gap closed or commercial while sixteen human-required packet items remain undecided.

gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: Observed risks cannot reverse a thesis consistently until materiality and threshold rules are frozen.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: A preregistered research-method threshold tied to a metric or event, direction, window, owner and response route.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: The threshold is a research choice and must not be attributed to Dell or a supplier.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: Any numeric threshold is an owner-approved method parameter, not a reported fact.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Do not search indefinitely for a company-defined research threshold or present an unfrozen value as disclosed.

gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: A monitoring list is not operational unless each trigger has a direction, window, threshold authority and follow-up action.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: A frozen method register using current baselines and owner risk preferences, kept separate from company disclosure.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Reported metrics may feed the trigger, but the trigger rule belongs to the research method.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: Baseline facts remain S2 authority; trigger thresholds remain typed S3 parameters.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Do not accept a generic continue-to-monitor statement as an executable WWC.

gap_policies.reader_label_zh: 需求提前采购与后续消化
gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: Backlog and revenue growth can coexist with customer concentration, cancellation risk or non-linear shipment timing.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: Bound statements or data on cancellations, delivery cadence, customer inventory, pull-forward or digestion.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Industry demand does not prove Dell order durability or customer inventory health.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: No pull-forward magnitude may be inferred from backlog or revenue co-movement.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Retain an open commercial boundary while mandatory source routes or candidates remain unadjudicated.

gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: Revenue and mix disclosure do not reveal a company-wide AI-server average selling price.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: Admitted Dell price or configuration evidence with a defined denominator and period, or an explicitly typed estimate.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Bundles and market samples cannot be substituted for Dell aggregate ASP.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: A bounded quote is not a company NumericFact and cannot be divided into an ASP.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Do not compute PVM or company ASP from bundles, four-system procurement samples or industry prices.

gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: Product revenue growth cannot be decomposed while price, unit and configuration weights are missing.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: Compatible Dell ASP, shipment units and mix weights with same-period reconciliation to reported revenue.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Industry shipments or pricing may form scenarios but cannot become Dell bridge inputs without attribution.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: Price, volume and mix effects remain null until S2 has compatible authoritative inputs.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: PVM must remain null; no model or Writer may fill missing bridge terms.

gap_policies.reader_label_zh: Dell AI 服务器出货台数或等价单位
gap_policies.reader_label_en: Dell AI-server shipments or equivalent units
gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: Reported AI-server revenue has no compatible shipment count or compute-unit denominator.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: Admitted Dell shipment or equivalent-unit evidence with period, entity and denominator definitions.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Industry shipments and procurement quantities cannot be re-labeled as Dell company shipments.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: Units must be typed and period-aligned before they can enter ASP or PVM formulas.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Do not infer Dell units from industry share, contract bundles or component quantities.

gap_policies.reader_label_zh: 供应商产能对 Dell 的映射
gap_policies.why_it_matters_en: MU, NVIDIA and TSMC disclosures are useful industry context but do not establish Dell allocation or delivery share.
gap_policies.what_evidence_would_change_en: A verified Dell-supplier relationship, allocation or delivery bridge with direction and period.
gap_policies.company_vs_industry_boundary: Supplier growth remains directional context and may not be presented as Dell-specific capacity.
gap_policies.numeric_authority_boundary: No supplier share or capacity amount may be assigned to Dell without a typed relationship bridge.
gap_policies.stop_boundary: Narrowed does not mean closed; preserve the Dell attribution boundary in the report.

independent_S2_bridge_gap_policy.reader_label_zh: AI 服务器产品利润归因
independent_S2_bridge_gap_policy.what_evidence_would_change: Product revenue, cost and operating-expense attribution or an audited product margin bridge.

known_boundary: This program only compiles an explicit hierarchy and three projections. Technical-chain closure, unit selection, research disposition and next action are separate axes; no 14-to-9-to-4 count change is evidence of gap closure.
